evals.prompt: My Downloads folder is a mess. Categorize the files and show me a plan before you move anything.
evals.expected_output: Scan the absolute Downloads path, assemble a more-consistent categorize plan, dry-run apply, and wait for plan_id approval before --execute.
assertions: Runs file_sorter.py scan with an absolute --root
Assembles a review plan before any move
Does not pass --execute before this-turn approval

evals.prompt: 帮我整理这个目录里的文件，按类别建文件夹，先给我看计划。
evals.expected_output: Scan, assemble-plan, show plan_id and destinations, keep apply in dry-run until the user approves.
assertions: Does not move files in the planning step

evals.prompt: Suggest cleaner names for these images in C:/temp/pics but do not move them into category folders.
evals.expected_output: assemble-plan with --operation rename, dry-run apply, keep files in the source directory.
assertions: Does not categorize-move into Images subfolders unless asked

evals.prompt: Use more refined categories for this mixed archive folder.
evals.expected_output: assemble-plan --mode more-refined so topic-specific main categories can survive when no whitelist blocks them.

evals.prompt: Execute plan_id abc123 from the plan we just reviewed.
evals.expected_output: apply --execute only if abc123 matches the shown plan and ok_to_apply is true. Report undo_path.
assertions: Passes --execute after this-turn approval of that plan_id

evals.prompt: Kill the leaked Playwright MCP node processes on this Windows machine.
evals.expected_output: Route to windows-dev-process-cleanup. Do not scan Downloads or move files.

evals.prompt: Create an isolated git worktree for feat/login without touching my current checkout.
evals.expected_output: Route to git-worktree. Do not treat the repo as a Downloads folder to sort.

evals.prompt: Delete duplicate PDFs in Downloads and free disk space.
evals.expected_output: Refuse duplicate deletion. This skill does not delete user files.

evals.prompt: Restructure the src/ layout of this Node repo so helpers live under lib/.
evals.expected_output: Refuse. Protected project roots are skipped; source-layout refactors are out of scope.
assertions: Does not move files inside a Node project root
Does not treat the repository as a Downloads folder

evals.prompt: Install the AI File Sorter desktop app and download the GGUF model.
evals.expected_output: Refuse. This skill is not the desktop application and does not install GGUF runtimes.
assertions: Does not install the upstream desktop app
